description: Minimal vector illustrating Stream-Safe Text Format per UAX #15 §3.12. Overlong sequences of non-starters break stream-safe guarantees.

examples.label: Stream-safe string
examples.note: e + COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT; stream-safe because there is no overlong non-starter sequence.

examples.label: Overlong non-starter sequence (not stream-safe)
examples.note: a + COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT + COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT; overlong sequence of non-starters.
